subject: gk
question: Microfinance programmes were first created by Nobel prize winning Economist Muhummad Yunus in what decade?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1970s**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Microfinance programmes were pioneered by Dr. Muhummad Yunus, an economist from Bangladesh, in the 1970s.

• He is the founder of Grameen Bank, which was established in 1983, but the microfinance concept was initiated in the 1970s.

• Dr. Yunus was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2006 for his efforts to create economic and social development from below.

• Microfinance involves providing small loans to the impoverished, which helps them start small businesses and escape poverty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Microfinance:**

• Microfinance is a financial service that provides small loans to low-income individuals or those without access to typical banking services.

• It aims to enable individuals to become self-sufficient by providing a means to invest in their small businesses or other income-generating activities.

• Microfinance can include loans, savings, insurance, and other financial products tailored to the needs of the poor.

• It is seen as a tool for poverty alleviation and economic development.

• **Grameen Bank:**

• Founded by Dr. Muhummad Yunus in Bangladesh, Grameen Bank is a pioneering institution in the field of microfinance.

• It is known for its innovative approach to providing small loans to the impoverished without requiring collateral.

• The bank has a unique system where loans are given to groups of borrowers who are collectively responsible for repayment.

• Grameen Bank's model has been replicated in various forms across the world.

• **Nobel Peace Prize 2006:**

• Dr. Muhummad Yunus and Grameen Bank were jointly awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2006.

• The award recognized their efforts in creating economic and social development through microcredit.

• The Nobel Committee highlighted that lasting peace cannot be achieved unless large population groups find ways in which to break out of poverty.

• Their work has provided millions of people worldwide with the opportunity to improve their lives.
